title: Discover
body: Understand the business, customers, requirements, and goals before anything is designed or built.

title: Strategize
body: Plan the architecture, user journey, design direction, and measurement needs as one connected brief.

title: Build
body: Implement the website, interfaces, and integrations in reviewable stages rather than one silent stretch of work.

title: Validate
body: Test functionality, responsive behaviour, accessibility, performance, and tracking against the brief.

title: Launch & Improve
body: Deploy the solution, confirm measurement, and identify practical opportunities for improvement.
